basis: S5b-1: a material's product is decided from the clause filing code its terms print and the full product name its title carries (checked on 39 materials of 13 products, 2026-10-24). Product types follow the filed name suffix after trailing qualifiers such as (分红型) are removed; 养老年金 is an annuity (user 2026-10-18). New products get an id generated from the clause filing code (user 2026-10-24). 2026-10-24.2 (review R3): a clause code starts with a listed issuer, so a label printed before it is never taken into the code. 2026-10-25.1 (review R3 remainder): only the material's own code — at the very start, followed by the title — may create a product or make a new version; a code elsewhere (after a label, or cited in the body) only confirms a registered product whose name the title carries. 2026-10-26.4 (S5b-5, review R1-R3 and the R2 remainders on PR #355): real on-sale terms do not open with their code; each prints its own code once on page 1, followed by the QR verification line, so that line marks the own code anywhere in the first two pages (checked on 20 terms of 20 products). The title is read at the start after stripping page numbers and 险种简称/险种代码 labels repeatedly; only when the start has none does the reader guide (阅读指引…产品提供) stand in, and only for terms, with one guide starting in the first anchor_chars, every guide naming the same product, and no code, verification line or title end word in the name, each guide read whole up to the next guide so an overlong or empty one is checked rather than skipped; otherwise there is no title. The start title is never checked against the guide, which some extractors garble. Every parenthesised qualifier is ignored when the type suffix is read, so 平安意外(A款)医疗保险 is accident medical. 专属商业养老保险 is supplementary pension (user 2026-10-26).
